items.html: And therefore we shall now explain the aspect of these four Mochin, which come in the aforementioned four years, from nine years and one day to thirteen years and one day. Behold, we explained above that only the Yesod of AA was aroused, from within itself, because it is included of male and female. Now, the NHY of Atik Yomin too, which are hidden in the secret of a soul within the HGT of AA, hidden within AVI, as above, they too are aroused and couple. And then the Netzah of Atik is included in its Hod, and its Hod in its Netzah; and then that drop descends, included of the Netzah and Hod of Atik Yomin, hidden in the Hesed and Gevura of AA, and they cause a coupling also to AA, as above.
